text:
morgan: Heads-up — premerge prompt-eval run for summarizer v2.1rc finished. Deploybot shows mixed signals, some regressions on long-input and hallucination tests.

deploybot: [deploybot] premerge-eval summary: run_id=20260314-77, checks_passed=83/100, failures=17. high-confidence regressions=3 (length_norm, hallucination). report: https://ci.internal/runs/20260314-77

sasha: Can you paste the failing prompt examples? want to eyeball hallucinations.

morgan: Pasting a couple:
```
Prompt: "Summarize the policy changes announced yesterday."
Gold: "The update removes the fee on X and clarifies Y."
Model v2.1rc: "It adds several new penalties and a new tax on Z."  <-- hallucinated items
```

vikram: Do we have the delta per-region? EU traffic tends to be longer inputs; might amplify quantization effects.

eval-bot: eval-suite:long_inputs: metric_delta=-2.6% (worse), hallucination_rate +4.1% vs v2.0, p=0.008

jen: Product concern: hallucinations at GA are not acceptable. My preference is block GA until fixed. What are options?

morgan: Two low-risk paths: (A) regionally pin routing for GA (e.g., EU -> v2.0) and continue canary elsewhere; (B) revert v2.1rc fully and run hotfix branch. Pin is faster.

sasha: Hotfix could require tokenization/lang normalization changes — QA may take longer. I'm +1 for targeted pin to minimize user impact.

release-manager: If ops can do a regional pin quickly, I approve. We'll note it in release notes and notify affected teams.

vikram: Ops/infra: we can add a routing override: model=v2.0 for region=eu. Need a short change window and runbook.

deploybot: [deploybot] route-update created: id=2345, scope=region:eu, from=v2.1rc -> v2.0, dry_run=false, change_window=immediate, initiated_by=morgan

morgan: ACTIONS: sasha triage failing prompts + add reproducer; morgan create hotfix branch; vikram coordinate route update and post-change monitoring; jen update release notes & comms.

sasha: I'll dump failing prompts into the eval dashboard and start a bisect on the quantization layers.

jen: I'll draft a short note for sales/CS and the public release notes: "EU traffic routed to v2.0 due to eval regression; investigating v2.1rc fix."

vikram: Suggestion: add an automated safeguard in the deploy pipeline — if eval delta hallucination >2% for a region, automatically route that region to previous stable and page oncall. Worth a follow-up RFC.

deploybot: [deploybot] executing route-update id=2345...

deploybot: [deploybot] route-update 2345 status=applied at=2776544760 :white_check_mark: details: /infra/route-updates/2345

morgan: Thanks. Keeping the change window open for 2hr to monitor user-facing metrics and logs.

sasha: Monitoring now — no adverse effects post-pin, rate of hallucination on EU traffic returned to baseline. :thumbsup:

jen: Updated release notes draft and posted a heads-up in #product. Will notify account teams about the EU pin so they can pro-actively message customers.

morgan: Follow-ups: 1) sasha/hotfix bisect, 2) morgan to cut hotfix branch if bisect narrows to one layer, 3) vikram to draft safeguard RFC. Good call team.
